cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked.

mechanism: Treat copying a baker's confident movement as correct process and recast the resulting dropped cake as quality-control success.
confusable: Not intentional sabotage: B2 exposes a mistaken copied tray movement; A3 covers it by inventing a successful test interpretation.
comparison: Customer-serving failure differs from evacuation confinement; no prop-only substitution.
seedUse: Uses the canonical Drive collapsed wedding cake/no damaged servings and S04 copied action; changes the cause explicitly rather than claiming literal seed dialogue reuse.
